summary: Verified the admin console dark-bleed bug is FIXED. Reproduced the original repro path: set consumer dark (localStorage wayly:app:appearance=dark + html.theme-dark + data-theme=dark), logged in as super_admin via 2-step TOTP (hello@wayly.com.au), navigated to /admin/users, then HARD REFRESHED. In every case <html> ends up with data-theme='light' and NO theme-dark class, .admin-root data-theme='light', body bg rgb(234,237,240) (cream) with heading color rgb(14,42,44) (near-black) on white cards — fully readable. Repeated hard-refresh 4 times: stable. Navigated Overview/Subscriptions/Audit Log/Health: all stayed light. Admin top-bar theme toggle (D/L) still works. On leaving /admin to a consumer route the consumer dark theme is correctly restored (data-theme=dark, class theme-dark). Consumer localStorage 'wayly:app:appearance' was never mutated by the admin console (stayed 'dark' throughout the admin session). Screenshots confirm no white-on-white; text/cards render as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is well-scoped: MutationObserver observes only class + data-theme attribute changes on <html>, guards with `applying` flag to avoid re-entrancy, and disconnects on unmount. Restoration on unmount reads wayly:app:appearance from localStorage and re-applies theme-dark class + data-theme attribute — matching ThemeProvider semantics.
useAdminTheme.js also writes data-theme to .admin-root only (scoped, not <html>), so the two hooks compose cleanly without clashing.
Minor: the observer callback runs on every child attribute mutation but is idempotent (early-return when state already matches) — cheap enough. No cleanup concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dark-bleed bug verified fixed in iter329. Repro pattern to reuse: (1) set localStorage 'wayly:app:appearance'='dark' + document.documentElement.classList.add('theme-dark') + setAttribute('data-theme','dark'), (2) inject wayly_admin_token via page.request TOTP flow, (3) navigate to /admin/*, (4) hard refresh. Expected: <html> data-theme='light', no theme-dark class, .admin-root data-theme='light'. Playwright's page.request works for /api/admin/auth/*; python urllib was blocked with 403 (WAF/UA filter).
rca of the issue: Original bug: The consumer ThemeProvider runs a useEffect on mount that reapplies its stored theme to <html> (setting class theme-dark + data-theme='dark' when user had chosen dark). Because AdminApp is nested under that provider, on hard-refresh the consumer provider's effect fires AFTER the admin's initial theme apply, overwriting <html> back to dark — leaving the light-designed admin CSS painted with dark globals (white text on white cards). Fix: AdminApp now installs a MutationObserver on <html>[class,data-theme] that re-asserts the admin theme (with an `applying` re-entrancy flag) whenever anything else mutates <html>, so consumer re-applications are immediately reverted while admin is mounted. On unmount, the observer disconnects and the consumer's stored theme is restored from localStorage. Verified end-to-end in preview.
